urdu.name: ابراہیم
urdu.long_meaning: Ibragim (ابراہیم) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم ابراہیم، نبی کا نام ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.long_meaning: Ibragim (ابراهیم) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ابراهیم، نام پیامبر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.long_meaning: Ibragim (إِبْرَاهِيم) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي إِبْرَاهِيم، النَّبِيُّ. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Ibragim can be understood through the Arabic form إِبْرَاهِيم, whose central sense is ibragim; abraham (prophet) (caucasian form). Ibragim is the Caucasian form of Arabic إِبْرَاهِيم (Ibrāhīm), the Quranic form of the prophet Abraham.

faq.a: Ibragim is associated with the Arabic form إِبْرَاهِيم, whose core sense is ibragim; abraham (prophet) (caucasian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ibragim?
faq.a: Ibragim is associated with Arabic. Ibragim is the Caucasian form of Arabic إِبْرَاهِيم (Ibrāhīm), the Quranic form of the prophet Abraham.
Yes — the underlying form إِبْرَاهِيم is Arabic.
Ibragim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ibragim should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ibrāhīm is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Abraham and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Ibragim mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ibragim is rendered ابراہیم and carries the sense ابراہیم، نبی کا نام.

faq.q: What does Ibragim mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ibragim is rendered ابراهیم and carries the sense ابراهیم، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is ib-ra-gim. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ibragim?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ibragim, ibragim. Script forms are إِبْرَاهِيم, ابراهيم, ابراهیم, ابراہیم, इब्रागिम.

faq.q: Is Ibragim a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
